Fields.Name: Ground Position
Fields.Description: Where the ground is under the foot. Set by the game when it isn't using raycasts.

Fields.Name: Ungrounded Event
Fields.Description: The event sent when the foot finds no ground.

Fields.Name: Vertical Error
Fields.Description: How far the foot is from the ground (output).

Fields.Name: Hit Something
Fields.Description: Whether the foot's raycast found ground (output).

Fields.Name: Enabled
Fields.Description: Whether IK applies to this leg.
